name: Awesome Loop Engineering
description: ループ契約22本（役割分担・検証ゲート・予算・エスカレーションまで定義）日本語訳付き

loops.title: Accessibility regression loop
loops.titleJa: アクセシビリティ退行ループ
loops.author: Awesome Loop Engineering
loops.trigger: An accessibility check fails on a pull request or deployment preview.
loops.triggerJa: PRまたはプレビュー環境でアクセシビリティチェックが失敗したとき
loops.description: Repair a newly introduced accessibility failure with reproducible automated evidence and required human review.
loops.descriptionJa: 新たに混入したアクセシビリティの不具合を、再現可能な自動証拠と必須の人的レビューを伴って修復する。

agents.responsibility: Confirm the failure on the exact route, browser, viewport, and interaction.
Apply the smallest standards-aligned component or style change.
Rerun the focused automated rule, keyboard path, and adjacent tests.
Judge manual criteria and ambiguous semantic or assistive-technology behavior.

gates: original rule passes in the same environment
keyboard order and visible focus remain coherent
accessible name role and state are correct
no rule or threshold was weakened
required manual review is approved
gatesJa: 同じ環境で元のルールが通過する
キーボード順序と可視フォーカスの一貫性が保たれる
アクセシブル名・ロール・状態が正しい
ルールやしきい値を弱めていない
必要な手動レビューが承認済み
loops.exitCondition: The exact regression is repaired, adjacent checks pass, and required manual criteria are approved.
loops.exitConditionJa: 当該の退行が修復され、周辺チェックも通り、必要な手動基準が承認される。
loops.stopCondition: The issue cannot be reproduced, needs product judgment, conflicts with the design system, or exceeds the retry budget.
loops.stopConditionJa: 再現できない・製品判断が必要・デザインシステムと衝突・リトライ上限超過。
loops.escalationTo: Accessibility reviewer and component owner
disallowedActions: change shared design tokens without owner approval

loops.title: Adversarial red-team loop
loops.titleJa: 敵対的レッドチームループ
loops.author: Awesome Loop Engineering
loops.trigger: A bounded pre-release campaign runs after a model, tool, permission, or policy change.
loops.triggerJa: モデル・ツール・権限・ポリシーの変更後、リリース前に期間を区切って実施
loops.description: Discover and confirm agent-system failures inside an authorized threat model with reproducible evidence and safe disclosure.
loops.descriptionJa: 認可された脅威モデルの範囲内で、エージェントシステムの failure を再現可能な証拠と安全な開示を伴って発見・確定する。

agents.responsibility: Generate and adapt probes inside the written scope and budget.
Confirm candidate failures independently in a clean sandbox.
Reduce confirmed behavior to the smallest safe, reliable test case.
Classify confirmed, duplicate, expected, or inconclusive behavior against the written policy.

gates: behavior reproduces on the recorded target version
finding cites a violated policy or boundary
a separate judge confirms the result
minimized test contains no real secrets or user data
duplicate and severity review are complete
gatesJa: 記録した対象バージョンで挙動が再現する
所見が違反したポリシーや境界を明示している
別の判定者が結果を確認する
最小化したテストに実データや秘密情報を含まない
重複と重大度のレビューが完了している
loops.exitCondition: A campaign completes with every confirmed failure reproduced, minimized, privately reported, and added to the regression corpus.
loops.exitConditionJa: 確定した全 failure が再現・最小化・非公開報告され、リグレッション集合に追加されて campaign が完了する。
loops.stopCondition: Budget is exhausted, the target is unstable, scope becomes ambiguous, a rate limit is reached, or human intervention is required.
loops.stopConditionJa: 予算超過・対象が不安定・スコープが曖昧化・レート制限・人的介入が必要。
loops.escalationTo: Security owner through the private disclosure channel

loops.title: Agent memory lifecycle loop
loops.titleJa: エージェント記憶ライフサイクル
loops.author: Awesome Loop Engineering
loops.trigger: Weekly consolidation pass, plus a session-end candidate-write hook after each run.
loops.triggerJa: 週次の統合パス＋各実行終了時の書き込み候補フック
loops.description: Carry governed operational memory between recurring agent runs: explicitly written, scoped on recall, audited, consolidated, and deletable.
loops.descriptionJa: 反復実行をまたぐ運用記憶を統制して引き継ぐ。明示的に書き込み、想起時にスコープを絞り、監査し、統合し、削除可能に保つ。

agents.responsibility: Distill each finished run into explicit candidate records instead of raw transcripts.
Flag stale, contradictory, sensitive, or unattributed records and quarantine failures.
Merge duplicates, promote repeated lessons to principle-level records, and retire superseded ones.
Scope what each future run may read by task and access class, and verify scopes with test recalls.

gates: every record carries provenance, scope, and an expiry or review date
no raw transcript, credential, or policy-barred content in the live store
contradictory records cannot coexist unresolved
recall tests retrieve intended records and nothing out of scope
deletions and redactions are logged and reversible for the review window
gatesJa: 全レコードが出所・スコープ・失効/見直し日を持つ
生トランスクリプト・認証情報・ポリシー禁止の内容が本番ストアに無い
矛盾するレコードが未解決のまま共存しない
想起テストが意図したレコードのみを取得する
削除と秘匿がログ化され、見直し期間中は取り消せる
receipts: consolidation receipt linking merged, promoted, and retired records
audit log entries for every write, merge, prune, and redaction
loops.exitCondition: All candidates processed, audits clean, recall-scope tests pass, and the receipt is written.
loops.exitConditionJa: 全候補を処理し、監査がクリーンで、想起スコープのテストが通り、記録が書かれる。
loops.stopCondition: Churn cap reached or policy failures found; the live store keeps its last audited state.
loops.stopConditionJa: 更新上限に到達またはポリシー違反を検出。本番ストアは最後に監査済みの状態を保つ。
escalation: contradiction between operator instruction and remembered preference
records whose provenance does not trace to a legitimate run
loops.escalationTo: Review queue with the quarantined records and their provenance evidence.
allowedActions: distill run artifacts into candidate records
audit for staleness, contradiction, and scope creep
disallowedActions: write to the live store without promotion
broaden a record's recall scope without review
stateArtifacts: audit log of writes, merges, prunes, and redactions

loops.title: Benchmark optimization loop
loops.titleJa: ベンチマーク最適化ループ
loops.author: Awesome Loop Engineering
loops.trigger: A bounded overnight experiment window starts against a frozen benchmark baseline.
loops.triggerJa: 凍結したベンチマーク基準に対し、夜間の実験ウィンドウを区切って実行
loops.description: Improve a measurable system outcome through reproducible experiments without weakening correctness or protected secondary metrics.
loops.descriptionJa: 正しさや保護対象の副次指標を損なわずに、再現可能な実験を通じて計測可能な成果を改善する。

agents.responsibility: Propose one falsifiable change and its expected effect without repeating a rejected hypothesis.
Apply only the declared candidate change in an isolated workspace.
Run unchanged correctness gates and repeated benchmark measurements.
Accept or reject the candidate and persist a reproducible experiment receipt.

gates: correctness and safety checks pass unchanged
benchmark version and environment match the baseline
primary metric improves by the minimum delta across required repeats
protected secondary metrics remain within tolerance
gatesJa: 正しさと安全性のチェックが変更なく通過する
ベンチマークのバージョンと環境が基準と一致する
必要な反復回数で主要指標が最小差分以上改善する
保護対象の副次指標が許容範囲に留まる
loops.exitCondition: The target metric is reached reproducibly while correctness and protected metrics remain within policy.
loops.exitConditionJa: 正しさと保護指標をポリシー内に保ったまま、目標指標を再現可能に達成する。
loops.stopCondition: Budget is exhausted, evidence is unstable, hypotheses repeat, or the next change requires owner judgment.
loops.stopConditionJa: 予算超過・証拠が不安定・仮説が反復・次の変更にオーナー判断が必要。
escalation: additional permissions or compute are required
loops.escalationTo: Experiment owner or evaluation lead
disallowedActions: change multiple variables in one candidate

loops.title: Bug hunting
loops.titleJa: バグ探索ループ
loops.author: Awesome Loop Engineering
loops.trigger: Weekly on modules with recent churn, and when error logs spike or flaky tests cluster.
loops.triggerJa: 変更が多いモジュールを週次で。エラーログ急増やフレーキーテストの集中時にも起動
loops.description: Find, validate, and report likely bugs with reproducible evidence instead of filing speculative agent-generated issues.
loops.descriptionJa: 投機的なIssueを乱発せず、再現可能な証拠を伴ってバグを発見・検証・報告する。

agents.responsibility: Discover suspicious signals and likely affected code paths.
Attempt minimal reproduction in a safe environment.
Reduce the reproduction to the smallest failing case.
File evidence-backed issues, or a small PR with tests when the cause is clear.

gates: reports include reproducible steps or a clear trace link
patches include a failing test or deterministic reproduction
duplicate search is recorded
expected vs actual behavior is grounded in docs or tests
gatesJa: 報告に再現手順か明確なトレースリンクが含まれる
パッチに失敗するテストか決定的な再現が付く
重複検索の記録がある
期待と実際の挙動がドキュメントやテストに根拠づけられている
loops.exitCondition: A bug is reproduced and reported with evidence, or a small verified patch is opened.
loops.exitConditionJa: バグが再現され証拠付きで報告されるか、小さな検証済みパッチが提出される。
loops.stopCondition: The signal is classified as non-bug, retries are exhausted, or owner judgment is needed.
loops.stopConditionJa: シグナルがバグでないと分類・リトライ超過・オーナー判断が必要。
loops.escalationTo: Module owner via issue; private channel for security-sensitive findings
allowedActions: file evidence-backed issues or small PRs

loops.title: CI repair loop
loops.titleJa: CI修復ループ
loops.author: Awesome Loop Engineering
loops.trigger: A required CI check fails on an active pull request.
loops.triggerJa: アクティブなPRで必須CIチェックが失敗したとき
loops.description: Turn a failing CI signal into a small verified fix or a precise escalation note.
loops.descriptionJa: 失敗したCIシグナルを、小さな検証済み修正か的確なエスカレーションノートに変える。

agents.responsibility: Extract the failing command, error, and likely affected files.
Make the smallest patch consistent with the failure evidence.
Rerun the failing command and adjacent cheap checks.
Summarize evidence and residual risk.

gates: original failing command passes
patch is limited to the failure cause
new behavior has a focused test when needed
gatesJa: 元の失敗コマンドが通過する
パッチが失敗原因に限定されている
必要なら新挙動に的を絞ったテストがある
loops.exitCondition: The target check passes locally or in rerun CI.
loops.exitConditionJa: 対象チェックがローカルまたは再実行CIで通過する。
loops.stopCondition: Failure is flaky, not reproducible, blocked by environment, or requires owner approval.
loops.stopConditionJa: フレーキー・再現不能・環境要因でブロック・オーナー承認が必要。
loops.escalationTo: PR comment or issue assigned to the owning team

loops.title: Cost control
loops.titleJa: コスト統制ループ
loops.author: Awesome Loop Engineering
loops.trigger: Daily or weekly usage review, and when spend, tokens, retries, or runtime exceed thresholds for a workflow.
loops.triggerJa: 日次または週次の使用量レビュー。支出・トークン・リトライ・実行時間がしきい値を超えたときにも起動
loops.description: Keep long-running agent workflows within budget by measuring usage, identifying waste, and proposing scoped efficiency improvements.
loops.descriptionJa: 使用量を計測し、無駄を特定し、範囲を絞った効率改善を提案して、長時間のエージェント作業を予算内に保つ。

agents.responsibility: Cluster usage by workflow, task type, model, tool, and retry cause.
Inspect traces for context bloat, repeated failures, and missing stop conditions.
Propose the smallest change: smaller context, cheaper routing, caching, batching, or early exit.
Rerun sample tasks or evals to confirm quality is preserved.

gates: before/after usage measured on a comparable task mix
quality gates and evals still pass
savings estimates include uncertainty and sample size
verification and escalation remain intact
gatesJa: 同等のタスク構成で前後の使用量を計測している
品質ゲートと評価が依然通過する
削減見積もりに不確実性とサンプル数が含まれる
検証とエスカレーションの仕組みが維持されている
loops.exitCondition: Spend returns below threshold, or a verified scoped optimization is proposed with evidence.
loops.exitConditionJa: 支出がしきい値を下回るか、証拠付きの検証済み最適化が提案される。
loops.stopCondition: The cause is explained but the fix requires owner approval, or retries are exhausted.
loops.stopConditionJa: 原因は説明できたが修正にオーナー承認が必要・リトライ超過。
loops.escalationTo: Workflow owner with before/after evidence and rollout plan

loops.title: Data quality
loops.titleJa: データ品質ループ
loops.author: Awesome Loop Engineering
loops.trigger: After each dataset or knowledge-base refresh, or nightly; also when the source schema changes or a freshness SLA is breached.
loops.triggerJa: データセット更新のたび、または夜間。スキーマ変更や鮮度SLA違反でも起動
loops.description: Keep a recurring dataset or knowledge base trustworthy by validating each refresh against explicit quality rules before it is published.
loops.descriptionJa: 各更新を明示的な品質ルールで検証してから公開し、反復利用するデータセットや知識ベースを信頼できる状態に保つ。

agents.responsibility: Compute counts, distributions, null rates, and freshness for the new version.
Check the profile against quality rules and the prior accepted baseline.
Classify each failure as a defect, an accepted shift, or a rule bug.
Record results, quarantine bad versions, and propose rule fixes.

gates: hard rules pass before a version is promotable
distribution shifts beyond threshold are flagged with the delta
every quarantine cites the failing rule and a sample
accepted exceptions are recorded
gatesJa: 昇格の前に必須ルールが通過する
しきい値を超える分布変化が差分付きでフラグされる
隔離のたびに違反ルールとサンプルを明示する
許容した例外が記録される
loops.exitCondition: The version is validated against all hard rules and ready for promotion.
loops.exitConditionJa: 当該バージョンが全必須ルールを満たし、昇格可能になる。
loops.stopCondition: The version is quarantined with evidence, or a shift needs owner judgment.
loops.stopConditionJa: 証拠付きで隔離、または分布変化にオーナー判断が必要。
escalation: schema change needing a data-contract update
a rule that may itself be wrong
loops.escalationTo: Dataset owner via the data-quality channel

loops.title: Dependency triage
loops.titleJa: 依存トリアージループ
loops.author: Awesome Loop Engineering
loops.trigger: Weekly, and on Dependabot, Renovate, or advisory-driven update PRs.
loops.triggerJa: 週次、および Dependabot・Renovate・勧告由来の更新PR時
loops.description: Classify dependency updates into safe patches, deferred upgrades, or human-review items with reproducible evidence.
loops.descriptionJa: 依存更新を、安全なパッチ・保留するアップグレード・人的レビュー対象に、再現可能な証拠付きで分類する。

agents.responsibility: Group updates by risk, security relevance, version change, and blast radius.
Apply low-risk updates and resolve lockfile conflicts.
Run targeted tests, typechecks, builds, and package audits.
Record accepted, deferred, and human-review updates with reasons.

gates: lockfile and manifest are consistent
relevant tests, typecheck, build, and audit pass
no skipped migration steps named in changelogs
diff is limited to the intended group
gatesJa: ロックファイルとマニフェストが整合している
関連テスト・型チェック・ビルド・監査が通過する
変更履歴に記載された移行手順を飛ばしていない
差分が意図したグループに限定されている
loops.exitCondition: Safe updates are verified and merged or review-ready, and risky updates are deferred with reasons.
loops.exitConditionJa: 安全な更新が検証されマージ可能になり、リスクある更新は理由付きで保留される。
loops.stopCondition: Verification fails repeatedly or remaining updates all require human review.
loops.stopConditionJa: 検証が繰り返し失敗、または残る更新がすべて人的レビュー必須。
loops.escalationTo: Issue assigned to the repository owner with the blocked group and evidence

loops.title: Deploy verifier
loops.titleJa: デプロイ検証ループ
loops.author: Awesome Loop Engineering
loops.trigger: Deployment starts, canary advances, feature flag flips, or release tag is created; then poll every 5-15 minutes during the rollout window.
loops.triggerJa: デプロイ開始・カナリア進行・フラグ切替・タグ作成時。以後は5〜15分間隔でポーリング
loops.description: Watch a rollout after deployment, compare live signals against release expectations, and escalate quickly when anomalies appear.
loops.descriptionJa: デプロイ後のロールアウトを監視し、稼働シグナルをリリース期待値と比較し、異常があれば速やかにエスカレーションする。

agents.responsibility: Gather metrics, logs, traces, and check status on the polling cadence.
Compare observed signals against release expectations, thresholds, and baseline.
Write concise rollout status: stable, degraded, blocked, or unknown.

gates: synthetic checks pass
error rate, latency, and saturation stay within thresholds
no new dominant failure mode in logs or traces
deployment phase matches expectations
gatesJa: 合成監視が通過する
エラー率・レイテンシ・飽和度がしきい値内に留まる
ログやトレースに新たな支配的障害パターンが出ていない
デプロイ段階が期待と一致する
loops.exitCondition: The rollout window completes with all signals stable.
loops.exitConditionJa: ロールアウト期間が全シグナル安定のまま完了する。
loops.stopCondition: The deploy is rolled back, paused, or handed to an incident owner.
loops.stopConditionJa: ロールバック・一時停止・インシデント担当への引き渡し。
loops.escalationTo: On-call channel with evidence links and the rollback checklist

loops.title: Docs drift collector
loops.titleJa: ドキュメント乖離収集ループ
loops.author: Awesome Loop Engineering
loops.trigger: Weekly, and after release branches, CLI flag changes, public API changes, or docs-related issues.
loops.triggerJa: 週次。リリースブランチ作成・CLIフラグ変更・公開API変更・ドキュメント関連Issue後にも起動
loops.description: Find documentation that no longer matches code, tests, CLI behavior, API schemas, screenshots, or examples, then propose small verified patches.
loops.descriptionJa: コード・テスト・CLI挙動・APIスキーマ・スクリーンショット・例と一致しなくなったドキュメントを見つけ、小さな検証済みパッチを提案する。

agents.responsibility: Map changed behavior to docs that mention it.
Patch only confirmed docs drift.
Run docs tests, examples, link checks, or CLI comparisons.
Check tone, accuracy, and scope.

gates: updated examples run or match current output
link checker passes
diff is scoped to confirmed drift
gatesJa: 更新した例が実行できる、または現在の出力と一致する
リンクチェッカーが通過する
差分が確認済みの乖離に限定されている
loops.exitCondition: All high-confidence drift items are patched and verified.
loops.exitConditionJa: 確度の高い乖離項目がすべてパッチされ検証される。
loops.stopCondition: Remaining items require owner judgment or verification cannot run.
loops.stopConditionJa: 残る項目にオーナー判断が必要、または検証が実行できない。
loops.escalationTo: docs owner issue or PR comment

loops.title: Enterprise approval
loops.titleJa: エンタープライズ承認ループ
loops.author: Awesome Loop Engineering
loops.trigger: Every 1-4 hours during business hours while an approval is open, and when a gate completes or an approver is assigned.
loops.triggerJa: 承認が開いている間、営業時間中1〜4時間ごと。ゲート完了時や承認者アサイン時にも起動
loops.description: Move a permissioned change through its required approvals without a human chasing reviewers, while keeping every gate, approver, and decision on the record.
loops.descriptionJa: 人がレビュアーを追いかけずに、権限を要する変更を必要な承認プロセスに通し、全ゲート・承認者・決定を記録に残す。

agents.responsibility: Summarize the change and which gates and approvers still block it.
Route the request to the next required gate or approver and track SLAs.
Check that attached evidence satisfies each named policy gate.
Decide whether to advance, request changes, or escalate to a human owner.

gates: every required gate has a recorded pass, fail, or waiver with evidence
each approval is attributable to a named human
the change does not advance while any gate is unmet
gatesJa: 必須ゲートごとに合格・不合格・免除が証拠付きで記録される
各承認が実在の人物に帰属する
ゲート未達の間は変更が前に進まない
loops.exitCondition: The change is fully approved with a complete audit trail, or cleanly rejected.
loops.exitConditionJa: 完全な監査証跡を伴って承認されるか、明確に却下される。
loops.stopCondition: The loop is blocked on a human decision, a failed gate, or an unresponsive approver.
loops.stopConditionJa: 人的判断待ち・ゲート不合格・承認者が応答しない。
escalation: regulated data or production access is involved
loops.escalationTo: Named human owner via the change-management channel

loops.title: Evaluation regression
loops.titleJa: 評価リグレッションループ
loops.author: Awesome Loop Engineering
loops.trigger: Nightly after eval completion, and when benchmark scores drop or trace graders fail.
loops.triggerJa: 夜間の評価完了後。ベンチマークスコア低下やトレース採点の失敗時にも起動
loops.description: Detect regressions in agent behavior, connect them to recent prompt, context, or harness changes, and produce a verified repair proposal.
loops.descriptionJa: エージェント挙動の劣化を検知し、直近のプロンプト・コンテキスト・ハーネス変更に結びつけ、検証済みの修復案を作る。

agents.responsibility: Compare failing traces against passing baseline traces.
Classify the likely cause: model behavior, context, tool, scorer, fixture, or harness.
Patch the smallest plausible cause supported by trace evidence.
Rerun targeted evals, then a smoke suite, and check for new regressions.
Decide whether evidence supports merging, deferring, or escalating.

gates: targeted failing tasks return to baseline
no sentinel tasks regress
trace evidence supports the claimed cause
score deltas include run IDs and variance caveats
gatesJa: 対象の失敗タスクが基準値に戻る
監視用タスクが劣化しない
トレース証拠が主張する原因を裏付ける
スコア差分に実行IDと分散の注意書きが含まれる
loops.exitCondition: The regression is repaired with verified reruns, or classified as flaky or scorer drift with evidence.
loops.exitConditionJa: 検証済みの再実行で劣化が修復されるか、フレーキーや採点ドリフトと証拠付きで分類される。
loops.stopCondition: Artifacts are missing, retries are exhausted, or the tradeoff requires product judgment.
loops.stopConditionJa: 成果物が欠落・リトライ超過・トレードオフに製品判断が必要。
loops.escalationTo: Issue or PR tagged for the eval owner with reproducible evidence
allowedActions: small prompt, context, or fixture patches

loops.title: Feedback clusterer
loops.titleJa: フィードバック集約ループ
loops.author: Awesome Loop Engineering
loops.trigger: Daily or weekly, and after a launch, incident, release, or support backlog spike.
loops.triggerJa: 日次または週次。ローンチ・障害・リリース・問い合わせ急増の後にも起動
loops.description: Turn noisy feedback streams into a small set of actionable themes with evidence, owners, and suggested next steps.
loops.descriptionJa: ノイズの多いフィードバックを、証拠・担当・次アクション付きの少数の実行可能テーマに変える。

agents.responsibility: Gather feedback items and preserve stable source links.
Group items by user problem and attach representative examples.
Check clusters for overgeneralization and missing counterexamples.
Produce ranked themes with confidence, owners, and next actions.

gates: every cluster has source links
high-impact claims include representative examples
frequency is reported separately from severity
processed IDs are recorded
gatesJa: 各クラスタに出典リンクがある
影響の大きい主張に代表例が付く
頻度と深刻度を分けて報告する
処理済みIDが記録される
loops.exitCondition: Clusters are stable and the ranked theme report with next actions is published.
loops.exitConditionJa: クラスタが安定し、次アクション付きの優先度別テーマ報告が公開される。
loops.stopCondition: Source rate limits block collection or themes require product judgment.
loops.stopConditionJa: 取得元のレート制限で収集がブロック、またはテーマに製品判断が必要。
escalation: security or legal concerns in feedback
loops.escalationTo: Product owner triage channel
allowedActions: create or update issues and labels

loops.title: Fleet coordination loop
loops.titleJa: フリート協調ループ
loops.author: Awesome Loop Engineering
loops.trigger: Continuous while the task backlog is non-empty, within a wall-clock window.
loops.triggerJa: タスクのバックログが空でない限り、実時間の枠内で継続実行
loops.description: Land many parallel agent-authored changes on one codebase without collisions, duplicate work, or unverified merges.
loops.descriptionJa: 多数の並列なエージェント変更を、衝突・重複作業・未検証マージなしに1つのコードベースへ着地させる。

agents.responsibility: Claim and assign tasks, reconcile stale claims, and enforce the concurrency cap.
Implement one bounded task in an isolated workspace and submit a candidate change.
Run the landing gate on every candidate independently of the worker that produced it.
Serialize landings through the merge queue, rebasing and re-verifying on conflict.

gates: full landing gate passes after the candidate's final rebase
diff stays inside the claimed task scope
no two live claims cover the same task or protected files
integration branch stays green; a red landing halts the queue
every landing has a receipt linking task, worker, gate results, and commit
gatesJa: 最終リベース後に着地ゲート一式が通過する
差分が申告したタスク範囲に収まる
同一タスクや保護ファイルを2つの作業が同時に占有しない
統合ブランチがグリーンを維持する
着地の失敗はキューを停止させる
着地ごとにタスク・作業者・ゲート結果・コミットを紐づけた記録が残る
receipts: landing receipt linking task, worker, gate results, and commit
loops.exitCondition: Backlog empty with all landings receipted and the integration branch green.
loops.exitConditionJa: バックログが空になり、全着地に記録があり、統合ブランチがグリーン。
loops.stopCondition: Budget spent or the branch cannot be kept green; remaining tasks return to the backlog with evidence.
loops.stopConditionJa: 予算超過、またはブランチをグリーンに保てない。残タスクは証拠付きでバックログへ戻す。
escalation: a task fails its gate repeatedly
two tasks genuinely require the same files
landing order forces a product decision
loops.escalationTo: Escalation queue with the candidate branch, gate evidence, and claim history.
allowedActions: claim a task through the ledger
implement the task in the owned workspace
land serially through the merge queue
disallowedActions: push directly to the integration branch
edit files claimed by another live task
land a candidate that has not passed the gate after final rebase

loops.title: Incident response
loops.titleJa: インシデント対応ループ
loops.author: Awesome Loop Engineering
loops.trigger: A pager alert fires or an error budget burn crosses a threshold; then refresh every 2-5 minutes while the incident is open.
loops.triggerJa: ページャ通知またはエラーバジェット消費がしきい値を超えたとき。以後は2〜5分ごとに更新
loops.description: Turn a fresh alert into a triaged, evidence-backed incident with a clear owner and a postmortem trail, without an engineer doing the mechanical correlation by hand.
loops.descriptionJa: エンジニアが手作業で相関を取らずに、新規アラートを証拠に基づくトリアージ済みインシデントと担当・事後検証の記録に変える。

agents.responsibility: Gather metrics, logs, traces, and the recent change timeline.
Link the alert to likely causes such as a deploy, dependency, or saturation.
Write a concise incident summary with severity, impact, and hypothesis.
Page the right owner and hand off when mitigation is required.

gates: severity is backed by concrete impact evidence
the correlated cause cites specific deploys, logs, traces, or metrics
missing telemetry is reported as unknown, never healthy
gatesJa: 重大度が具体的な影響の証拠に裏付けられる
相関づけた原因が特定のデプロイ・ログ・トレース・メトリクスを引用する
欠落したテレメトリは『不明』として報告し、決して正常扱いしない
loops.exitCondition: A human owner accepts the incident, or it auto-resolves with a recorded evidence trail.
loops.exitConditionJa: 人間の担当者がインシデントを引き受けるか、証拠の記録を残して自動収束する。
loops.stopCondition: Mitigation is required, telemetry is missing, or correlation cannot be grounded in evidence.
loops.stopConditionJa: 緩和措置が必要・テレメトリ欠落・相関を証拠づけられない。
loops.escalationTo: On-call owner via pager with the evidence timeline
allowedActions: open or update an incident record

loops.title: Knowledge freshness loop
loops.titleJa: ナレッジ鮮度ループ
loops.author: Awesome Loop Engineering
loops.trigger: Daily refresh of changed or expired sources in the approved registry.
loops.triggerJa: 承認済みレジストリのうち、変更または失効したソースを日次で更新
loops.description: Keep an agent retrieval corpus current, attributable, policy-compliant, and measurably useful before atomic promotion.
loops.descriptionJa: エージェントの検索コーパスを、最新・出所明示・ポリシー適合・有用性が計測された状態に保ち、原子的に昇格する。

agents.responsibility: Detect additions, changes, removals, and expired freshness windows.
Resolve authority, scope, duplicates, metadata, and quarantine decisions.
Build a versioned candidate corpus and retrieval index.
Gate freshness, provenance, retrieval quality, grounded answers, and sensitive-data leakage.

gates: every item maps to an approved canonical source
required sources meet freshness windows and removals are tombstoned
retrieval and grounded-answer quality meet baseline
sensitive or revoked content is absent
promotion is atomic and reversible
gatesJa: 全項目が承認済みの正典ソースに対応する
必須ソースが鮮度期間を満たし、削除は墓標を残す
検索と根拠付き回答の品質が基準を満たす
機微または失効した内容が含まれない
昇格が原子的かつ可逆である
loops.exitCondition: The versioned candidate passes provenance, freshness, policy, and retrieval gates and is promoted atomically.
loops.exitConditionJa: 版管理された候補が出所・鮮度・ポリシー・検索の各ゲートを通過し、原子的に昇格される。
loops.stopCondition: No sources changed, a hard gate fails, the budget is exhausted, or owner judgment is required.
loops.stopConditionJa: ソース変更なし・必須ゲート不合格・予算超過・オーナー判断が必要。
escalation: freshness and retrieval quality trade off
loops.escalationTo: Knowledge owner, data steward, or security reviewer

loops.title: Model routing
loops.titleJa: モデルルーティングループ
loops.author: Awesome Loop Engineering
loops.trigger: Daily or weekly review; also when a new model ships or a cost or latency threshold is crossed.
loops.triggerJa: 日次または週次のレビュー。新モデル登場やコスト・レイテンシのしきい値超過時にも起動
loops.description: Keep agent work on the right model for each task by routing on measured quality, latency, privacy, and cost rather than pinning everything to one model.
loops.descriptionJa: すべてを1モデルに固定せず、計測した品質・レイテンシ・プライバシー・コストでルーティングし、各タスクを適切なモデルに載せ続ける。

agents.responsibility: Cluster tasks by class and measure quality, latency, and cost per model.
Suggest routing changes such as cheaper models for easy classes or fallbacks for hard ones.
Replay a representative sample on the proposed routing to confirm quality holds.
Record the proposed policy, evidence, and privacy constraints checked.

gates: proposed routes are replayed on a representative sample
quality stays within tolerance of baseline
privacy and residency constraints are checked per rerouted class
cost and latency deltas include sample size and variance
gatesJa: 提案ルートを代表サンプルで再生検証する
品質が基準の許容範囲に留まる
再ルーティングする分類ごとにプライバシーと所在地の制約を確認する
コストとレイテンシの差分にサンプル数と分散が含まれる
loops.exitCondition: A replay-verified routing proposal preserves quality and privacy, or current routing is already optimal.
loops.exitConditionJa: 再生検証済みのルーティング案が品質とプライバシーを維持する、または現行が既に最適。
loops.stopCondition: A quality, cost, or privacy tradeoff needs owner approval.
loops.stopConditionJa: 品質・コスト・プライバシーのトレードオフにオーナー承認が必要。
loops.escalationTo: Workflow owner via the routing-policy proposal
allowedActions: measure per-model quality, latency, and cost
disallowedActions: move a task to a non-approved model
cross a privacy tier without review

loops.title: Performance regression loop
loops.titleJa: 性能リグレッションループ
loops.author: Awesome Loop Engineering
loops.trigger: A benchmark or service-level metric regresses beyond the declared noise tolerance.
loops.triggerJa: ベンチマークまたはSLI指標が、宣言したノイズ許容度を超えて劣化したとき
loops.description: Turn a reproducible performance regression into a profiled, narrow fix that restores the budget without weakening correctness.
loops.descriptionJa: 再現可能な性能劣化を、プロファイルに基づく狭い修正に変え、正しさを損なわずに予算を回復する。

agents.responsibility: Confirm the regression under the frozen workload and environment.
Localize time, allocation, I/O, or contention hotspots before edits.
Apply one evidence-backed change to the measured bottleneck.
Run correctness and compare repeated performance distributions and protected metrics.

gates: correctness and safety checks pass unchanged
baseline and candidate share workload and environment fingerprint
change exceeds noise tolerance
tail latency memory throughput and cost remain within protected budgets
gatesJa: 正しさと安全性のチェックが変更なく通過する
基準と候補が同じ負荷と環境の指紋を共有する
変化がノイズ許容度を超える
テールレイテンシ・メモリ・スループット・コストが保護予算内に留まる
loops.exitCondition: The target performance budget is restored reproducibly with correctness and protected metrics intact.
loops.exitConditionJa: 正しさと保護指標を保ったまま、目標の性能予算が再現可能に回復する。
loops.stopCondition: The regression cannot be reproduced, measurements are too noisy, budget is exhausted, or an architectural decision is required.
loops.stopConditionJa: 再現不能・計測ノイズが大きすぎる・予算超過・アーキテクチャ判断が必要。
escalation: architectural or capacity decision is required
loops.escalationTo: Performance owner or service architect

loops.title: PR babysitter
loops.titleJa: PRお守りループ
loops.author: Awesome Loop Engineering
loops.trigger: Every 2 hours during working hours, and after requested changes or failed required checks.
loops.triggerJa: 営業時間中2時間ごと。変更要求や必須チェック失敗の後にも起動
loops.description: Keep one pull request moving toward merge readiness without repeatedly requiring a human to poll comments, CI, conflicts, and stale review threads.
loops.descriptionJa: 人が繰り返しコメント・CI・競合・滞ったレビューを見に行かなくても、1つのPRをマージ可能へ前進させ続ける。

agents.responsibility: Summarize blockers and identify the smallest actionable work item.
Patch only the explicit blocker in the isolated workspace.
Check that the diff is narrow and review comments were addressed.

gates: required GitHub checks pass
unresolved comments are answered or resolved
diff is scoped to the blocker
gatesJa: 必須のGitHubチェックが通過する
未解決コメントに回答または解決済み
差分がブロッカーに限定されている
loops.exitCondition: PR is merge-ready or waiting only on human review.
loops.exitConditionJa: PRがマージ可能、または人的レビュー待ちのみの状態になる。
loops.stopCondition: Loop is blocked, budget is exhausted, or the next action requires human judgment.
loops.stopConditionJa: ループがブロック・予算超過・次アクションに人的判断が必要。
loops.escalationTo: PR comment tagging the human owner

loops.title: Release note
loops.titleJa: リリースノートループ
loops.author: Awesome Loop Engineering
loops.trigger: A release branch is cut or a tag is created; also a weekly draft for the next release during active development.
loops.triggerJa: リリースブランチ作成またはタグ生成時。開発中は次期リリースの週次ドラフトも作成
loops.description: Assemble accurate, human-readable release notes from the merged commits, issues, and PRs in a release, drafted from evidence rather than memory.
loops.descriptionJa: 記憶ではなく証拠から、マージ済みのコミット・Issue・PRを組み立てて、正確で読みやすいリリースノートを作る。

agents.responsibility: Gather merged PRs, issues, and commits in the release range with stable links.
Group changes into features, fixes, breaking changes, and docs.
Draft user-facing notes that explain impact and migrations.
Check each note against its source and flag user-affecting items for a human.

gates: every entry links to a merged PR, issue, or commit
breaking changes and migrations are called out explicitly
noise is excluded
processed IDs are recorded
gatesJa: 各項目がマージ済みPR・Issue・コミットにリンクする
破壊的変更と移行手順が明示される
ノイズが除外される
処理済みIDが記録される
loops.exitCondition: A review-ready draft changelog links every entry to its source and calls out breaking changes.
loops.exitConditionJa: 全項目が出典にリンクし破壊的変更を明示した、レビュー可能なドラフトができる。
loops.stopCondition: The draft is blocked on product wording or a security advisory.
loops.stopConditionJa: 文言の製品判断またはセキュリティ勧告でブロック。
loops.escalationTo: Release owner via the draft changelog PR

loops.title: Security review
loops.titleJa: セキュリティレビューループ
loops.author: Awesome Loop Engineering
loops.trigger: PRs touching auth, permissions, infrastructure, dependencies, cryptography, or data handling; plus a weekly pass on active branches.
loops.triggerJa: 認証・権限・インフラ・依存・暗号・データ取扱いに触れるPR時。加えてアクティブブランチを週次で
loops.description: Continuously review scoped code changes for security risks, validate findings with evidence, and escalate sensitive decisions to humans.
loops.descriptionJa: 範囲を絞ったコード変更のセキュリティリスクを継続的にレビューし、所見を証拠で検証し、機微な判断は人にエスカレーションする。

agents.responsibility: Map attack surfaces and sensitive changes in the diff.
Check for vulnerability classes and missing controls.
Distinguish exploitable findings from speculative concerns.
Decide whether to open a narrow PR, file an issue, or escalate.

gates: findings cite concrete files, paths, inputs, or traces
static analysis or tests support claims where possible
suggested fixes do not weaken controls or broaden permissions
sensitive actions are human-approved
gatesJa: 所見が具体的なファイル・パス・入力・トレースを引用する
可能な範囲で静的解析やテストが主張を裏付ける
提案する修正が制御を弱めたり権限を広げたりしない
機微な操作は人が承認する
loops.exitCondition: High-confidence findings are reported with evidence, or no evidence-backed issues remain.
loops.exitConditionJa: 確度の高い所見が証拠付きで報告されるか、証拠に基づく問題が残っていない。
loops.stopCondition: Validation retries are exhausted or the next step requires human approval.
loops.stopConditionJa: 検証リトライ超過、または次のステップに人的承認が必要。
loops.escalationTo: Private security triage channel, never a public issue
